meaning: Passed means the indexed part IDs and locally mapped PDF page bounds are consistent. It does not accept unresolved source, geometry, original-equipment, workshop or owner-review requirements.

families.name: Spare & tools
families.remaining: Actual compact-spare label, wheel/retainer/jack condition and dimensional fit must be checked on the vehicle.
families.coverageDescription: 1985–88 catalogued compact 15 × 4-inch wheel, open mounting center, separate tire, valve, cross-compartment retaining rod and supports, jack screw/pivots and lug wrench. Catalog service identities do not prove this car’s installed tire, every internal part, measured mounting coordinates, lifting capacity or hood/sunroof-stowage clearance. This is a static construction view; follow the factory procedure for vehicle lifting.

families.name: Wipers & washer
families.remaining: Standard/pulse application is a source-backed preview. Actual installed equipment, connector/pump variants and measured linkage travel remain unverified.
families.coverageDescription: Shared parked arms/blades, separate LH/RH links and pivots, standard motor field/armature/gear/park construction, option-specific CD4 pulse motor/board/cover, and washer bottle/bottom pump/check valve/hoses/nozzles. Original measured tooling, sweep, clearance, delay calibration, pump internals, full wiring and rear-defroster circuit remain unverified. Adjacent-year washer construction is identified separately.

families.name: Interior
families.remaining: Original trim/RPO codes, upholstery patterns, hidden mechanisms and full hardware count are unresolved; appearance approval remains owner-held.
families.coverageDescription: Separate two-tone AR9 seat covers, foam, frames, supports, tracks, recliner controls, headrest speakers and mounting hardware; belts, dashboard/map pocket, vertical outlets, console skeleton, ashtrays, radio, rear storage, door trim/pulls, carpet, early pillar garnish, headliner, visors, mirror and steering-wheel trim. Existing instrument, HVAC, ECM, brake and lamp assemblies link to their detailed explorers. Local forms, exact fastener inventory, hidden mechanism internals, material codes and physical operation remain unverified. Riveted/bonded construction views are not removal procedures.

families.name: Wiring & controls
families.remaining: VIN does not identify ECM calibration, all harness terminals or installed equipment. Several supporting location views are explicitly adjacent-year.
families.coverageDescription: Original 1985 cluster with separate dials, pointers, pod/lens, center gauges, lower tach oil scale and ten indicator/bulb pairs. Numbered fuse panel and ratings checked against the 1985 owner’s manual; separate fuse elements, sockets, hinge and releases, rear-console ECM enclosure/calibration carriers and 24/32-cavity plugs, battery junction/grounds and distinct turn/hazard flashers. Whole loom circuits, instrument internals, horn units, exact connector tooling, circuit boards and wire lengths remain incomplete. These are static construction views.

families.name: Starting / charging
families.remaining: Original battery/alternator/starter identity and ratings require installed labels; internal winding and local casting detail are reconstructed.
families.coverageDescription: Side-terminal battery with heat shield and hold-down; Delco starter, solenoid and drive construction; early generator cast frames, rotor/stator, regulator/rectifier, brushes, bearings and bracket. Original unit stamping/rating, measured castings, exact windings, cable routes, belt interfaces and electrical diagnostics remain to verify.

families.name: Lighting
families.remaining: Lamp optical tooling, harness terminal details, local dimensions and actual option content remain unverified.
families.coverageDescription: Separate front park/turn lamps, four side markers, early notchback rear lamp layers and bulb chambers, license lamps, four overhead reading/dome lamps, manual ashtray lamps and optional courtesy/compartment lighting. Shared native geometry replaces former surface proxies. Exact optical tooling, dimensions, circuit routing, detailed instrument lighting and seal profiles remain unverified.

families.name: Headlights
families.remaining: Original actuator gear/contact variants, measured pivots/stops, original connector faces and aiming/service evidence remain separate checks.
families.coverageDescription: Separate LH/RH sealed beams, retaining and aiming hardware, buckets, spring-loaded covers, pivots and links, early motors with gear/cushion/brush/contact construction, two actuator relays and driver-side isolation relay with nested coils, armatures, contacts, diodes, open connector shells and 16 individually selectable blades. Separate white/green/gray motor conductors, blue disconnect branches and front-harness C/D fusible links. Raised and closed endpoint poses preserve the low exterior profile. Exact dimensions, optical tooling, gear ratios, measured switch geometry, complete harness circuits and linkage travel remain unverified. Sealed-lamp and riveted-motor separation illustrates construction.

families.name: HVAC
families.remaining: C41/C60 variants must follow the actual vehicle equipment. Original compressor identity, refrigerant system routing/charge and internals remain unresolved.
families.coverageDescription: Heater case, option-specific core and controls, air doors, blower cage/motor/resistor, open distribution ducts and C60 evaporator/accumulator/electric actuators, plus compressor/clutch/mounts, condenser and refrigerant pipes/hoses. Configure air conditioning to switch C41 and C60 previews; the VIN does not identify this option. Original compressor identity, complete internal construction and circuits, measured housings/routing and calibrated travel remain unverified. Adjacent-year service diagrams supplement the catalog applications with their year limits recorded.

families.name: Body
families.remaining: Tooling surfaces, fastener inventory, seals, hidden mechanisms and original trim options require further evidence and owner appearance approval.
families.coverageDescription: Shared exterior skins, separate rockers/door trim/side glass, hood mechanical stay and release, rear decklid torque rods and latch, door hinge straps/pins/latches, wheelhouse liners and panel retaining sets. Revised exterior includes independent mirrors, handles, moldings, bumper pads, fuel door, intake, antenna, wiper arms/blades, roof glass and spoiler previews, plus separate AD3 hinge tongues/bushings, rear release housing/button, trim frames and air deflector. Exact panel sections, body datums, attachment coordinates, mechanism travel, option-specific torque rods, calibrated window/lock travel, motor and latch internals, measured mechanism tooling and complete lock wiring remain incomplete. This is a static construction explorer, not a body-alignment or repair procedure.

families.name: Exhaust
families.remaining: SE black versus selected bright tailpipe appearance is explicit. Original exhaust measurements, catalyst/muffler internals and full hot-movement clearance remain unverified.
families.coverageDescription: Manifolds, crossover and shields, spring-loaded downpipe joint, early pellet converter cutaway, transverse muffler, twin tailpipes, clamps, shields and spring hangers. Catalogued 1985–86 assemblies are distinguished from later applications. Local bends, exact profiles, clearances, pellet count and muffler internals remain unverified. Welded-part separation illustrates construction, not a removal procedure.

families.name: Fuel
families.remaining: Original pump/sender calibration, dimensions, tank internals and exact tube/hose routing require further evidence.
families.coverageDescription: Early tank shells, straps, pump/sender, driver-side filler, filter, distinct feed/return routes, vapor canister and pump relay. Welded shell separation is an illustrative cutaway. Detailed dimensions, factory routing, pump internals and sender calibration remain unverified; the typical 1986 pump drawing is adjacent-year evidence.

families.name: Suspension
families.remaining: Owner reports WS6. Actual spring tags/rates, bushing stiffness, measured pivots and full-travel interference remain unverified.
families.coverageDescription: Separate front shocks and coils, formed control arms, ball joints, bushings, rear strut stacks and toe links, early cradle, 23 mm front stabilizer, manual steering rack and passenger-side damper. Spring rates/codes, tooth counts, local pivot coordinates and exact stamped/cast profiles remain unverified. Hubs and knuckles can be inspected in the Brakes explorer.

families.name: Engine
families.remaining: Original casting/part variants, dimensional tolerances, all passages, complete fastener quantities and accessory internals remain unverified. Published nominal values do not establish full measured geometry.
families.coverageDescription: Engine internals, ignition and service hardware, including nine-piece nested hydraulic lifters and separate water-pump construction selections. Measured castings, complete passages, original pump internal variants, routing and some accessory internals remain incomplete.

families.name: Transmission
families.remaining: Owner reports four-speed. Installed gearbox code, speedometer gear variant, shift cable geometry, shim thicknesses and bearing fits require further evidence.
families.coverageDescription: Case, gear trains, reverse idler, synchronizers, bearings, differential, selector and clutch. Gear profiles and casting dimensions are reconstructed. Detailed hydraulics, CV joints and mounting hardware remain incomplete.

families.name: Cooling
families.remaining: Original fan/cap/hose variants, measured pipe bends and complete fluid-path validation require physical checks.
families.coverageDescription: Radiator, fan, asymmetric inlet and return pipes, recovery bottle and heater circuit preview. Hose bends, fan variant, clearances and local dimensions need further verification. Thermostat and water pump can be opened through the engine service views.

families.name: Brakes
families.remaining: Original casting identities, complete hose travel, piston internals, hydraulic calibration and torque/service sequences require separate verification.
families.coverageDescription: Four separate corners, front integral rotor/hubs, rear hub units, calipers and parking actuators, composite master, tandem booster, lines and cables. Nominal rotor dimensions follow the 1985 DIY manual. Casting profiles, detailed fits, hose clearances, rear piston clutch internals and valve calibration remain unverified.
